cases.remaining_gate: No installed-profile canary, managed activation, rollback or inherited endurance qualification. Independent delta review is narrower than full implementation review.
cases.acceptance_oracle: After dependencies/merge/installation changes, rerun affected joins and retained gates on the actual candidate; source-ready is distinct from live-verified.
cases.negative_case: Reuse pre-merge evidence without dependency/source applicability checks.

cases.title: Abort after partial fencing has no safe resume contract
cases.remaining_gate: Local snapshot/publication races are covered. External fences/ACKs, atomic local custody/dispatch intent, and automatic post-commit recovery are not complete.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Use ABORTING on the same transition; reconcile every acknowledged fence. Before publication only, reacquire a strictly newer admission generation for the still-current parent, or remain parked. After publication recover the committed successor only.
cases.negative_case: Owner A retires the old admission generation; owner B times out. Reopening the parent dispatch gate does not restore legitimate authority and must not revive old tokens.

cases.title: Recovery states can park forever without a durable wake condition
cases.remaining_gate: Local snapshot/publication races are covered. External fences/ACKs, atomic local custody/dispatch intent, and automatic post-commit recovery are not complete.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Each parked phase records dependency, bounded next check, deadline, attempt accounting and visible terminal reason. Reconcile by stable transition ID after lost acknowledgments. Stop ordinary polling after terminal budget exhaustion.
cases.negative_case: A receipt owner recovers after an outage, but no model turn occurs to poll it; READY is never reached and the user must bridge again.

cases.title: Unknown effects block the context needed to reconcile them
cases.remaining_gate: Pure pressure policy and serialized-request bounds exist; hard shared budget reservation, actual route accounting and calibration remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Separate NORMAL and RECONCILIATION candidate/readiness modes. Recovery-only mode uses a qualified narrow observation lane; it cannot repeat the effect or invoke unrestricted shell. Every provider disclosure still requires normal policy admission.
cases.negative_case: The qualifier has no mode for a cold recovery-only context, while the example expects the successor to observe an UNKNOWN operation.

cases.title: Token reduction is incorrectly mandatory for every recovery cause
cases.remaining_gate: Pure pressure policy and serialized-request bounds exist; hard shared budget reservation, actual route accounting and calibration remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: PRESSURE requires measured useful runway gain. PROVIDER_REPAIR requires a typed, observed route fault and a verified fresh-context capability instead; no semantic-quality claim may bypass the pressure predicate.
cases.negative_case: A provider thread is unusable even though the correct reconstructed prompt has the same small size. The numeric-only guard rejects a valid route repair.

cases.title: Positive qualification facts default to true
cases.remaining_gate: Pure pressure policy and serialized-request bounds exist; hard shared budget reservation, actual route accounting and calibration remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Require every qualification fact explicitly, reject non-boolean flags, and label all local decisions non-authorizing. Production must consume owner-bound witnesses rather than adopting these fixture booleans.
cases.negative_case: A caller omits both coverage and owner-currentness observations and the fixture qualifier still returns a valid candidate.

cases.title: The presentation contract has no executable source-backed reference fixture
cases.remaining_gate: Local compiler tests do not qualify selected-route current disclosure authority, natural-language dependency completeness or native Rust render-prompt-v2 integration.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Add a closed synthetic fixture format, an external required-ID oracle, exact UTF-8 span/digest verification, a pure renderer and golden-output tests. Keep it a prototype contract, not a replacement production compiler.
cases.negative_case: The supplied tests check words in handwritten Markdown, not preservation of required records, exact source spans, or the output of a deterministic renderer.

cases.title: Deterministic content and per-attempt envelopes are conflated
cases.remaining_gate: Local compiler tests do not qualify selected-route current disclosure authority, natural-language dependency completeness or native Rust render-prompt-v2 integration.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Separate stable content projection digest from each exact serialized delivery/attempt receipt. Golden tests bind deterministic content and role mapping; transport nonces are fresh and explicitly bound, not removed after sealing.
cases.negative_case: A valid retry changes request/attempt IDs or observation time; requiring identical complete invocation bytes encourages reuse of stale transport identity.

cases.title: Input preservation lacks an explicit root-scoped inbox watermark
cases.remaining_gate: Actual caller refusal is locally exercised with provider doubles. Live useful-work continuation, cold owner recovery, and sealed provider/effect attempts remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Persist authentic input first in the existing ingress owner with logical-root sequence/dedup identity; bind the included high-watermark. Old-session aliases route to the owner tip, while branches remain distinct. Do not acknowledge unsaved input or consume it twice.
cases.negative_case: User input lands at an old physical session during publication. Both paths claim it was handled, or neither carries it into the new context.

cases.title: Durable references can be collected before publication or power recovery
cases.remaining_gate: Local snapshot/publication races are covered. External fences/ACKs, atomic local custody/dispatch intent, and automatic post-commit recovery are not complete.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Have the artifact owner establish a retention pin before publication and bind it to the transition; transfer/reconcile pin reachability after commit. Document process-crash versus power-loss assumptions, fsync/DB mode and bounded orphan retention.
cases.negative_case: A blob is written and acknowledged, then garbage collection removes its last temporary reference before the local transaction pins it.

cases.title: Owner acknowledgments have no explicit transition and incarnation binding
cases.remaining_gate: Local snapshot/publication races are covered. External fences/ACKs, atomic local custody/dispatch intent, and automatic post-commit recovery are not complete.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Bind each owner receipt to transition, task/profile, expected predecessor/target, relevant artifact and admission generations, owner incarnation and status. Expiration alone proves neither death nor takeover. Revalidate under the actual owner contract.
cases.negative_case: An acknowledgment from an older transition or a restarted owner is replayed as the current fence/activation result.

cases.title: Task fencing does not establish exclusive workspace mutation
cases.remaining_gate: Local lineage/branch tests are supporting evidence; current-policy retrieval, revocation, retention and unified live UI require route evidence.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Require an existing owner-enforced workspace lease or equivalent conditional write/snapshot isolation on touched paths. Noncooperating writers produce conflict and re-observation, never silent overwrite or auto-stash.
cases.negative_case: Another authorized task uses the same worktree and mutates a file between observation and effect; a task-only fence does not cover it.

cases.title: Action-dependent selection is circular when the successor changes action
cases.remaining_gate: Local compiler tests do not qualify selected-route current disclosure authority, natural-language dependency completeness or native Rust render-prompt-v2 integration.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Use a bounded orientation/reconciliation view when no evidence-backed frontier exists. Proposed actions name prerequisites; new material dependencies require retrieval/re-materialization before the ordinary action. Declared coverage is never universal semantic completeness.
cases.negative_case: The model chooses a different permissible action with dependencies that were not in the planned working set.

cases.title: The base model allows an old ordinary effect during preparation
cases.remaining_gate: Local negative witnesses and repeat-rebase tests are not cross-owner crash/fault injection or real repeated provider rollovers.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Add an explicit local admission gate and asynchronous operation phases to model/tests; test the gate independently of the external fence. Preserve original results as historical bounded evidence, not upgraded proof.
cases.negative_case: After request_rollover, the base model still offers effect_admitted_by_epoch_0 before fence acknowledgment. Its tests do not check the local freeze requirement.

cases.title: Packet verifier omits unexpected special files
cases.remaining_gate: Installed tuple, native owner capabilities, compatibility and real binary baseline remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Reject non-regular objects and symlinks; bound files/bytes/depth, hash checked open descriptors, and state immutable-snapshot assumptions. Byte integrity is still not origin authentication.
cases.negative_case: An unexpected FIFO is ignored and the verifier reports a complete matching inventory.

cases.title: Retries can consume unbounded resources inside one rebase attempt
cases.remaining_gate: Pure pressure policy and serialized-request bounds exist; hard shared budget reservation, actual route accounting and calibration remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Budget rebase admission once per transition and separately cap compilation/reconciliation calls, elapsed active recovery and output/retention bytes through the existing budget owner. Duplicate wakeups do not mint allowance; quota wait is not provider repair.
cases.negative_case: Two allowed rebase attempts each retry owner reads, source scans or candidate renders indefinitely.

cases.title: Calibration can reward a safe system that never continues
cases.remaining_gate: No matched-budget selected-route calibration, held-out outcomes or measured cost/quality claim.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Preregister intention-to-treat task denominators, eligible automatic-continuation rate, needless blocks/manual interventions and completion/time limits. Report correlated epoch failures at task level, not independent trials.
cases.negative_case: An arm refuses most difficult tasks, consumes little quota and reports no unsafe effects; successful-only metrics make it appear superior.

cases.title: Model exit criteria use optimization-removable assertions
cases.remaining_gate: Local negative witnesses and repeat-rebase tests are not cross-owner crash/fault injection or real repeated provider rollovers.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Use explicit result validation and nonzero exit on an unexpected base or mutation result; test optimized Python execution with deliberately bad results.
cases.negative_case: Running a modified/broken model with Python optimization may suppress the checks that are intended to fail its command.

cases.title: Release stages and inherited catalog are not an executable closure boundary
cases.remaining_gate: No installed-profile canary, managed activation, rollback or inherited endurance qualification. Independent delta review is narrower than full implementation review.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Include the recovered 172-ID catalog unchanged and a conservative applicability crosswalk. Separate offline-ready, isolated-route-qualified, canary-ready, live-verified and retained-program-complete predicates; no early stage claims later evidence.
cases.negative_case: A global all-required gate includes canary/live checks that can run only after staged activation. The 172 prior IDs also require an external lookup before an executor can enumerate them.

cases.title: Required source and excerpt can be altered together
cases.remaining_gate: Local compiler tests do not qualify selected-route current disclosure authority, natural-language dependency completeness or native Rust render-prompt-v2 integration.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Bind admitted source digests/classes and required-record spans/status/freshness to an externally supplied, immutable owner/test oracle. A production expectation must be acquired through the current authenticated owner, never constructed from the candidate being checked.
cases.negative_case: Changing the no-merge requirement, its source hash and exact excerpt together preserves the required ID and passes. Integrity against candidate-declared bytes is not authenticity against the admitted snapshot.

cases.title: Task, control, mode and scope are outside the oracle
cases.remaining_gate: Local compiler tests do not qualify selected-route current disclosure authority, natural-language dependency completeness or native Rust render-prompt-v2 integration.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Bind task, profile, worktree, audience, current control revision, mode and manifest identity in the external snapshot. Scope changes require new owner-approved observations. Retain source and control invalidation at actual dispatch.
cases.negative_case: A candidate can retain required IDs while changing task identity, control revision or recovery mode. Syntactic validity cannot establish current context ownership.

cases.title: Malformed shapes and alternate entry points bypass bounded refusal
cases.remaining_gate: Local compiler tests do not qualify selected-route current disclosure authority, natural-language dependency completeness or native Rust render-prompt-v2 integration.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Apply a shared bounded tree/type/depth/aggregate-byte check before either parsed or direct validation. Reject duplicate keys, nonfinite values, lone surrogates, malformed collection members and unknown fields with explicit failures. No coercive recovery.
cases.negative_case: Unhashable lists raise TypeError; direct validation accepts 169,712 bytes despite the 128-KiB parser limit. A wrapper can misclassify unexpected exceptions or bypass raw-size checks.

cases.title: Directory breadth is unbounded in the inventory verifier
cases.remaining_gate: Local negative witnesses and repeat-rebase tests are not cross-owner crash/fault injection or real repeated provider rollovers.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Count all filesystem entries, bound path length and directory depth, and reject empty/unmanifested directory branches in the immutable snapshot. Preserve nonregular/hardlink refusal.
cases.negative_case: File-count and depth limits do not bound the number of empty directories scanned. A shallow directory tree can exhaust work before a manifest mismatch.

cases.title: Post-extraction verification does not safely admit the ZIP itself
cases.remaining_gate: Local negative witnesses and repeat-rebase tests are not cross-owner crash/fault injection or real repeated provider rollovers.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Provide a separately inspectable standard-library archive verifier/extractor with externally supplied archive hash, portable unique names, type/method/encryption/entry/expanded-byte limits, CRC checks, private new destination and cleanup on failure. The destination must not preexist.
cases.negative_case: A file verifier cannot prevent unsafe archive path, duplicate-name, special-file or oversized expansion behavior before extraction. The packet lacks a bounded admission procedure for that step.

cases.title: Stage metadata permits real-owner gates to look offline-qualified
cases.remaining_gate: No installed-profile canary, managed activation, rollback or inherited endurance qualification. Independent delta review is narrower than full implementation review.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Correct each gate stage and define explicit evidence scope. Validate result coverage, command/disposition, source/candidate tuple, reviewed evidence bindings and stage prerequisites. No summary boolean or packet test counts as actual-route evidence; stage evaluator is advisory and cannot grant activation.
cases.negative_case: CT-033 and several new owner/ingress cases are assigned offline; a DAG check verifies order only. There is no exact candidate/evidence-class stage predicate.

cases.title: The required participant set can become a candidate-selected subset
cases.remaining_gate: Local snapshot/publication races are covered. External fences/ACKs, atomic local custody/dispatch intent, and automatic post-commit recovery are not complete.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Derive the required participant closure from the qualified route/task owner configuration, bind its revision externally, and verify exact coverage at publication and readiness. Bind each ACK to transition/scope/artifact/generation/incarnation and disposition. Optional observers cannot substitute for required effect owners.
cases.negative_case: Per-owner ACK bindings do not establish that every necessary authority owner was included. Dropping a slow owner from the candidate participant set can falsely make all listed ACKs complete.

cases.title: Materialization refresh and dispatch attempt need one sealed binding
cases.remaining_gate: Actual caller refusal is locally exercised with provider doubles. Live useful-work continuation, cold owner recovery, and sealed provider/effect attempts remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: CAS-bind dispatch to the exact materialization digest/revision, task/control/inbox watermark, route/incarnation, attempt ID and admission generation. Before admission replace a stale pending intent; after admission never rewrite its payload. Settle or quarantine late responses under that attempt and current control. Operation-ID intent collisions explicitly refuse.
cases.negative_case: The same successor may have several immutable briefs; a queued or already-admitted request can refer to an older one. Stable successor identity alone cannot prevent stale dispatch or late-response tool admission.

cases.title: Separate recovery budgets need a shared hard-cap accounting rule
cases.remaining_gate: Pure pressure policy and serialized-request bounds exist; hard shared budget reservation, actual route accounting and calibration remain unqualified.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Use existing-owner atomic reservations keyed by stable attempt. Ordinary and recovery lanes share applicable parent hard caps, units and source authority; an explicitly granted recovery reserve is not a new allowance. Keep uncertain attempts charged/reserved until actual owner settlement. Unknown subscription usage is unknown, not zero or an inferred dollar cost.
cases.negative_case: A recovery-mode check can continue with no ordinary task budget. That is only valid for an independently authorized reservation that still respects any shared provider/task hard cap; two pending attempts cannot each spend the remaining balance.

cases.title: Single-epoch golden fixtures do not test partial requirement supersession
cases.remaining_gate: Local snapshots and checkpoint inspection exist; continuous complete workspace/effect/process capture is not established.
cases.acceptance_oracle: Add a source-bound multi-epoch requirement sequence with independently frozen expected active requirements after each control event. Replacing the test criterion or widening one file boundary must preserve the independent no-publish rule. Model notes cannot supersede user requirements; ambiguous changes stay unresolved.
cases.negative_case: A perfect snapshot fixture can still coexist with a broken reducer that drops an older unrelated prohibition during the second or third epoch. Required-set construction remains an untested semantic seam.
